145796.l: Aromia bungii, commonly known as red-necked longhorn beetle, is a species of wood-boring beetle belonging to the family of longhorn beetles (Cerambycidae) that is native to eastern Asia. It was described by the entomologist Franz Faldermann in 1835 from Mongolia. It is common and native in different parts of China and South Korea and has been reported from the neighboring parts of Vietnam, North Korea, far eastern Russia and Japan. Further, the beetle is invasive in Europe (first record in 2010) and Japan (first record in 2012), spreading with wood-packing materials and through infested nursery plants.
